idle: You are signed in. A real MySQL session is created only when you press Run for the first time, so your quota is not spent for nothing.
starting: Starting a MySQL session on the server, usually a few seconds...
ready: The MySQL session is ready. Data in the session is lost when it expires or when you switch engine, sign out or close the tab.
cut: The server cut this result: it keeps at most the first 10,000 rows.

explain.estimated: This plan comes from the MySQL EXPLAIN and the statement has not run: row counts are the optimizer's estimates, not real counts.

notSimulated.btree: The MySQL B-Tree cannot be simulated in this version. Switch to PostgreSQL to see a real tree.
notSimulated.tryChange: Try a fix cannot be simulated on MySQL: CREATE INDEX commits at once, so it needs a table copy, which this version does not have.
notSimulated.capacity: Capacity cannot be simulated on MySQL because its B-Tree cannot be read yet.
notSimulated.mentor: Mentor does not support MySQL yet, because SQL proposed by the AI is not test-run on MySQL.
notSimulated.empty: Cannot explain: there is no SQL statement. Not simulated.
notSimulated.multiple: Cannot explain: EXPLAIN takes exactly one SQL statement. Not simulated.
notSimulated.unsupported: Cannot explain: only SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and REPLACE can be explained, or MySQL returned a plan shape we cannot read. Not simulated.

full.title: The MySQL server is full
full.body: All MySQL sessions are in use by other people. Try again in a few minutes, or use PostgreSQL right now.

userLimit.title: You already have another MySQL session
userLimit.body: Each person gets one session at a time. It may be in another tab or left over from earlier; it expires on its own within 15 minutes. Close the other tab or wait, then try again.

quota.title: All MySQL sessions for today are spent

timeBudget.title: Statement time for MySQL is spent for the last 24 hours
timeBudget.body: Statement time on the server has its own limit. PostgreSQL still works as usual.

rate.title: You are going too fast
rate.body: Wait a moment and try again.

unreachable.title: Cannot reach the MySQL machine
unreachable.body: This is a server-side problem, not your SQL and not because you ran out of quota. Try again in a few minutes.

timeout.title: The MySQL machine took too long to answer
timeout.body: The request timed out. The statement may still be running; if retrying fails, create a new session.

tooLarge.title: Result too large
tooLarge.body: The result exceeds what can be sent to the browser. Add a LIMIT or select fewer columns.

notConfigured.title: MySQL is not ready
notConfigured.body: The server is not configured to run MySQL. Use PostgreSQL.

unavailable.title: MySQL is temporarily unavailable
unavailable.body: The quota could not be checked or the server is low on disk. This is not because you ran out; try again in a few minutes.

busy.title: The connection is busy
busy.body: The previous statement is still running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.

queryTimeout.title: The statement ran over 15 seconds and was cut
queryTimeout.body: Simplify the statement or reduce the amount of data.

diskQuota.title: The session used up its disk space
diskQuota.body: The session was cancelled. Create a new one with less data.

expired.title: The MySQL session has expired
expired.body: The data you created in the session (tables, rows) is gone. Choose: start an empty session, or rebuild and re-run the statements you ran before.

err.replay: Rebuild and re-run {count, plural, one {# statement} other {# statements}}
